claim: In Juju, a user is any person able to log in to a Juju controller.
Users can be created in two ways: Implicitly by bootstrapping a controller into a cloud or explicitly by adding a user to a controller (`juju add-user`).
A user logs in to a Juju controller using a username and a password.
The user created implicitly gets the username `admin` and  is prompted to create a password the first time they attempt to log out.

A user created explicitly gets the username assigned to them when being added (via `juju add-user`) and is prompted to create login details when they register the new controller with their Juju client.
Every user is associated with an access level.
The default level for the user created implicitly (`admin`) is the controller `superuser` access level, which means they can do everything at the level of the entire controller.

The default level for a user created explicitly is the controller `login` level, which means they can do nothing on the controller other than register it with their client and log in to it -- for anything more they must be granted a higher level explicitly.
A Juju user may have different abilities, according to the access level they have been granted.
This document describes the various access levels and the corresponding abilities.
Abilities: Log in to the controller.
Granted: Automatically by bootstrapping a controller or by having the username 'admin'.
Abilities: Do anything that it is possible to do at the level of a controller.
A controller can manage models on many clouds.
With cloud-level access you can give a user permission to access one cloud but not another related to that controller.
Granted: Via command-juju-grant-cloud.
Grant another user model-level permissions.
Granted: Via command-juju-grant-cloud.
Abilities: You can do anything that it is possible to do at the level of a cloud.
Abilities: View the content of a model without changing it.
Abilities: Deploy and manage applications on the model.
Abilities: Do anything that it is possible to do at the level of a model.
Abilities: View offers during a search with command-juju-find-offers.
Abilities: Relate an application to the offer.
Abilities: You can do anything that it is possible to do at the level of an offer.
